units.source_text: 明天是宝宝夭折四十九天，哪怕推迟一天走也好嘛。

en.t: Tomorrow will be the forty-ninth day since the baby died, so surely it would be all right even if you delayed your departure by just one day.
Everyone tried to persuade me like this again.

units.source_text: 可是，我还是拿学校有事做借口，没有答应她们。

en.t: But I still used having business at school as an excuse and did not agree to their request.
Mother kept nagging back and forth, saying:
